## Freed v26.9.1001

More reliable device enrollment and Google Contacts recovery

### Fixes

- Match Google Drive enrollment certificates to the complete device request so valid certificates can reach verification
- Recover from the observed expired Google Contacts sync token response with one fresh read, discarding partial results and preserving unrelated errors

### Downloads

**macOS:** `.dmg` (Apple Silicon or Intel, signed + notarized)  
**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
